NAME:
  webhop - expose a local server through a WebHop gateway

USAGE:
  webhop [command] [flags]

COMMANDS:
  http       start an HTTP tunnel to a local server
  issuer     create and manage key sets, which sign origins' tokens
  token      issue and revoke origins' tokens
  version    print the version
  help       help about any command

EXAMPLES:
  webhop http 8080 --token <token>
  webhop token issue app1.example.com

Run `webhop help <command>` for details. Version 2.2.0.

result.stdout:
NAME:
  http - start an HTTP tunnel to a local server

USAGE:
  webhop http [address:port | port | url] [flags]

EXAMPLES:
  webhop http 8080 --token=<token>             forward to http://localhost:8080
  webhop http 8080                             the same, with the token in WEBHOP_TOKEN
  webhop http app.local:80                     forward to another host on your network
  webhop http https://localhost:7001           forward to a local https server (self-signed is fine)
  webhop http 3000 --host-header=rewrite       send Host: localhost:3000 (Vite, webpack dev server)
  webhop http 8080 --gateway=https://gw.example.com/   for a token that serves only paths
  webhop http 8080 --log=stdout                log lines instead of the live screen

FLAGS:
  --token string         the origin's token, wh_… (default: WEBHOP_TOKEN)
  --gateway string       the gateway's scheme, host and port, instead of the token's
                         (default: WEBHOP_GATEWAY)
  --host-header string   Host header sent to the local server: `rewrite` for the
                         target's host, or any value (default: the public host)
  --connections int      tunnels to keep open; caps concurrent requests (default 10,
                         at most the token's limit)
  --log string           where to write logs: stdout, stderr, false or a file path.
                         stdout/stderr replace the live screen (default false)
  --log-level string     debug, info, warn, error or crit (default info)
  --log-format string    term or json (default term)
  -h, --help             help for http

result.stdout:
NAME:
  issuer - create and manage key sets, which sign the tokens of a gateway's origins

USAGE:
  webhop issuer init <host> [flags]      a new key set for a gateway; prints whk_… for it
  webhop issuer list                     the key sets on this machine
  webhop issuer public <host|file>       print the set's whk_… again
  webhop issuer rotate <host|file>       a new signing key; the old one only verifies

EXAMPLES:
  webhop issuer init webhop.example.com
  webhop issuer init *.example.com --ept /t-7f3k9q
  webhop issuer init example.com/api/v1 --allow /frontend/

FLAGS:
  --allow string          more hosts or paths tokens may claim (repeat or comma-separate)
  --ept string            the tunnel endpoint (default /webhop)
  --lifetime duration     how long tokens are valid by default (default 30d)
  --max-lifetime duration the longest a token may be valid (default 90d)
  --set string            the set's file, instead of one named after the host in
                          /tmp/inspectra-help-webhop-e4254593-e227cdef/xdg-config/webhop/keys

A host picks its own set, else the wildcard one label up (app1.example.com picks
*.example.com). Write _.example.com for *.example.com in shells that expand *.
